about_the_game:
Please Note

This game is my first solo development project.

It is primarily created as a portfolio piece, so it should not be expected to deliver a fully polished gameplay experience. Thank you for your understanding and feedback.

Description

The Maze: Treasure Hunters is a game for 2-4 players where you become a hunter fighting for treasure.

Each round begins outside the walls of a mysterious labyrinth. Inside, obstacles await you in the form of pitch darkness, the unknown, and opponents who were once your friends. To win, you'll need to memorize your moves, mark your route in your guild book, and try to anticipate the actions of other treasure hunters.

Find or steal the key and open the hidden chest... or become another lost soul in the labyrinth.

Game Features

  • Turn-based multiplayer for 2-4 players.

  • Competitive elements.

  • Randomly generated labyrinth.

  • Limited visibility.

  • Pixel graphics and a guild atmosphere.

short_description: Feel like a true adventurer and explore a dark labyrinth. In this turn-based tactical game, you'll search for keys, use weapons to slow down your opponents, and map the labyrinth based on your own and others' movements.
